paper_title: SimSMoE Solving Representational Collapse via Similarity Measure
caption: : SMoE Routing Policy
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the BPC (Bits Per Column) values over training steps for two models, SMoE Validating and SimSMoE Validating. The x-axis, labeled “Training Steps,” represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 50 x10^3, with tick labels spaced every 10 x10^3. The y-axis, labeled “BPC,” represents a linear scale ranging from approximately 1.6 to 2.2. The SMoE Validating line, depicted in purple and marked with a solid diamond, begins at a value of approximately 1.76 at training step 0 and decreases to a value of approximately 1.12 at training step 50 x10^3. The SimSMoE Validating line, shown in magenta and marked with a solid square, starts at a value of approximately 1.84 at training step 0 and decreases to a value of approximately 1.08 at training step 50 x10^3.
